name: split-layout
title: SplitLayout
description: Master–detail layout: a resizable list pane beside a detail pane, built on ResizablePanelGroup (sizes can persist with autoSaveId). Below lg only one pane shows: the list, or the detail with a Back button; `showDetail` is controllable so selecting an item can switch panes. Both panes are labelled regions. Fills its container.
author: gntik-ai
